observedFacts: Normal triggered abilities are optional unless the print explicitly marks them mandatory; they use the stack and permit responses.
Inspecting a hidden front is private information, not revealing it to the other players.
Stealth prevents a face-up play but does not itself prohibit a later reveal.
Destruction differs from sacrifice. Hidden entities do not receive character damage merely from their front.
FAQ monitor permission is available anytime while the monitor is not exhausted.
implementationBoundary: An explicit free information command records actual monitor inspections; it does not add a cost, priority requirement or new player permission.
Inspection projections and view rendering never create inspection events or advance randomness; existing trusted-clock expiration processing is retained.
A player-controlled destroying effect supplies its true actor; an automatic world frame placeholder does not.
Condition gates retain the event-time two-blue-assets observation and recheck the original ability controllers assets on resolution, following the existing conditional-trigger implementation pattern.
acceptanceClaim: Source interpretation and author native WIP only; not independent review or published acceptance.
